cohort: 180 pregnant women aged 18-35 years with a gestational age >24 weeks
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had more complications, a higher rate of C-section, and preterm delivery compared to those without COVID-19.
mod_finding: The frequency of C-section was higher in the COVID-19 group (62.22%) compared to the non-COVID-19 group (26.7%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more frequent in the COVID-19 group (28.89%).
